chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from Al-Hajjal, from Thal'abah ibn Maymun, from Zurarah ibn A'yan, who said:

I saw the shirt of Ali (peace be upon him) in which he was killed, in the presence of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him). Its lower part was twelve shibr, and its body (main part) was three shibr, and I saw blood splashes in it.

key_terms.شِبْر: A unit of length, the span of an open hand

ai.seo_question: What were the dimensions and condition of the shirt in which Imam Ali (AS) was killed?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the physical reality of Imam Ali’s martyrdom through the testimony of Zurarah ibn A'yan, who observed the specific dimensions and bloodstains of the shirt presented by Imam Muhammad al-Baqir. The detailed description of the garment serves as tangible evidence (burhan) of the event, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the historical authenticity of the Ahl al-Bayt's sacrifices and their direct transmission of knowledge through the Imams.
